documents.notes: 'How we assess undergraduate applications' (the 'How to apply' URL redirects here). 'If you are unable to find a suitable referee, we may be able to accept your application without one' (with exceptions). Additional documents are requested by email and uploaded to NottinghamHub; none is named. The page states no academic year.

items.quote: Admissions staff at the University of Nottingham look for the following information on the UCAS form:
However, your statement will be read to better understand you and your motivation for university study, and in some cases your statement will be assessed.
We expect applications to the University of Nottingham to be supported by a reference, written in English.
items.notes: 'one reference per application is sufficient and, where possible, should be an academic reference.'
